milestones.name: Web reader v0.1

milestones.ships: Text extraction in the library; hosted reader on Cloudflare: render, search, select, navigate, print, offline, accessible, no upload; command palette, column-aware copy, page appearance modes, phone layout, network indicator

milestones.name: Desktop reader beta
milestones.ships: Signed installers for three OSes, file associations, tabs, auto-update channels

milestones.name: Annotator
milestones.ships: Markup, drawing, review threads, stamps, XFDF

milestones.name: Content editor
milestones.ships: Add and edit text, images and vectors

milestones.name: Forms and signing
